note: Leads are not verified parsers. Ranks are assigned only among verified paths.

leads.name: github.com/pingcap/tidb/ast
leads.reason: AST node types only (old TiDB path); parsing is in the parser package. Importer count from the pkg.go.dev search snippet.

leads.name: github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pkg/sql/parser
leads.reason: Not importable as a library path. The newest version the Go proxy resolves for github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach is v20.1.17+incompatible (h1:K1cIUwI9...); its pkg/sql/parser ships sql.y but not the generated sql.go and help_messages.go (listed in the package .gitignore), so the package does not compile from the module, and later CockroachDB releases are not published as importable module versions. Cockroach Labs publishes the parser as github.com/cockroachdb/cockroachdb-parser for library use (selected under its own importer count, 13); the auxten extraction is also selected. This snippet count (1,972) is not transferred to either path. Checked 2026-11-17.

leads.name: github.com/pingcap/tidb/parser
leads.reason: Predecessor path of the selected github.com/pingcap/tidb/pkg/parser: the TiDB parser moved from parser/ to pkg/parser, and the last module version at the old path is v0.0.0-20231013125129-93a834a6bf8d. Excluded as a renamed predecessor (trust-dns-proto/zend-json precedent); its snippet count (1,190) is not added to the selected path. Checked 2026-11-17.

leads.name: vitess.io/vitess/go/vt/sqlparser
leads.reason: sqlparser.NewTestParser().Parse / Parser.Parse return an AST Statement (Select, Insert) for MySQL-dialect text.

leads.name: github.com/pingcap/parser
leads.reason: Archived standalone module of the same TiDB parser, superseded by github.com/pingcap/tidb/parser and then github.com/pingcap/tidb/pkg/parser (selected). Excluded as a predecessor (rename precedent). Earlier check: the newest tagged module v3.1.2+incompatible has no test_driver package, so literals need the parser_driver from the full TiDB module. Checked 2026-11-17.

leads.name: github.com/xwb1989/sqlparser
leads.reason: 2018 extraction of vitess go/vt/sqlparser (untagged; pinned to pseudo-version 120387863bf2). Not byte-identical to the selected vitess v0.24.5 sqlparser: 0 of 12 same-named non-test source files identical, 23.9% of its 19,192 lines in matching blocks. SplitStatementToPieces and Parse give the oracle summary on both controls; selected as a separate path in the vitess family.

leads.name: github.com/pingcap/tidb/pkg/parser
leads.reason: Current TiDB parser module (no tagged releases; pinned to the snapshot's proxy pseudo-version of commit 1e84b3595a3e). parser.New().Parse with the documented test_driver package returns ast.StmtNode values that give the oracle summary on both controls; Go coverpkg covers the parser package and the AFL++ bridge differs between the controls.

leads.name: github.com/blastrain/vitess-sqlparser/sqlparser
leads.reason: Fork of an older vitess sqlparser with a bundled TiDB parser used only for DDL/SHOW/admin statements (untagged; pinned to pseudo-version a139afbb1aba). Not byte-identical: 0 of 7 same-named sqlparser files identical to xwb1989/sqlparser (73.1% of 9,084 lines matched) or vitess v0.24.5 (27.1%). sqlparser.Parse gives the oracle summary on both controls; selected as a vitess-family path.

leads.name: github.com/pganalyze/pg_query_go/v6
leads.family: PostgreSQL grammar (libpg_query extraction of the PostgreSQL server parser)
leads.reason: cgo binding to the bundled libpg_query 17-6.2.5 C sources (PostgreSQL grammar family). pg_query.Parse gives the oracle summary on both controls; Go binding lines plus native libpg_query C lines are covered (Clang profile), and AFL++ feedback comes from the allowlisted native gram.c, scan.c and parser.c objects; selected.

leads.name: github.com/auxten/postgresql-parser/pkg/sql/parser
leads.reason: Third-party extraction of CockroachDB v20.1.11 pkg/sql/parser with generated files checked in. BSL 1.1 code whose CockroachDB 20.1 Change Date (2023-04-01) has passed, so it is Apache-2.0 licensed; parser.Parse gives the oracle summary on both controls; selected as a CockroachDB-family path.

leads.name: github.com/rqlite/sql
leads.reason: SQLite-dialect hand-written parser (untagged; pinned to pseudo-version 5c0832fea6e1). NewParser(reader).ParseStatements gives the oracle summary on both controls; selected.

leads.name: github.com/cockroachdb/cockroachdb-parser/pkg/sql/parser
leads.reason: Official Apache-2.0 extraction of the CockroachDB parser (v0.25.2, CockroachDB v25.2). parser.Parse gives the oracle summary on both controls; selected as a CockroachDB-family path separate from the v20.1 auxten extraction (none of 7 same-named parser files identical, 36.6% of auxten's lines matched).

leads.name: github.com/AfterShip/clickhouse-sql-parser/parser
leads.reason: ClickHouse-dialect hand-written parser. NewParser(text).ParseStmts parses both valid controls (dialect-neutral subset) into SelectQuery/InsertStmt ASTs that give the oracle summary; selected.

leads.name: github.com/akito0107/xsqlparser
leads.reason: Go port of the early sqlparser-rs design (Go source, no shared code with the Rust crate). NewParser(reader, GenericSQLDialect).ParseSQL gives the oracle summary on both controls; selected.

leads.name: github.com/krasun/gosqlparser
leads.reason: Small subset parser. gosqlparser.Parse v1.0.5 rejects both valid controls with 'unexpected rune' (checked 2026-11-17); its documented grammar covers single-table SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE with == comparisons and double-quoted strings, without joins, functions, GROUP BY or ORDER BY.
